description: This file contains build definitions and macros for building firmware images and boot scripts for different hardware targets in an embedded Linux project. It defines build procedures, device configurations, and image assembly instructions.

methods.name: Build/boot-overlay
methods.description: Builds a bootable overlay image including kernel, device tree blobs, bootscript, and filesystem image, then compresses it with UBIFS.

methods.name: Build/bootfs.tar.gz
methods.description: Creates a tar.gz archive of the boot filesystem, extracting and packaging kernel and other boot files.

methods.name: Build/recovery-scr
methods.description: Generates a recovery boot script image using mkimage.

methods.name: Build/apalis-emmc
methods.description: Prepares combined images for the Apalis device, including image assembly and cleanup.

methods.name: Build/ventana-img
methods.description: Creates an image for the Ventana device, including kernel, device tree blobs, bootscript, and compressed root filesystem.
